$comment: buddy/requests@1: the map of what was asked, one per project (docs/buddy/requests.md). Every requirement of the inputs (a PRD line, a prototype screen) is an item with its destination: covered by a change or milestone, excluded (by a change or milestone, or for a reason), deferred with its reason, waiting for a question; no destination means nobody has it yet. Optionally its priority, with its origin and why (R132, R136), and what it depends on (R132). Written by core/src/requests.mjs; the rules a shape cannot express are in core/src/verify.mjs.

last.$comment: the highest id ever given, so a removed id is never given again

priority.$comment: MoSCoW (R132): Won't is not stored, it is what is excluded or deferred

priority_origin.$comment: where the priority comes from (R136): prd, stated by the PRD; assumed, proposed by Buddy until the owner confirms it; human, the owner's word. Absent on a priority set before R136: read as human

priority_why.$comment: one line: the PRD's citation for prd, Buddy's reason for assumed, optional for human

depends_on.$comment: the requests this one needs first: assumed when Buddy proposed it, human when the owner said or confirmed it
